patterns.evidence: The boat's mooring location (marina_name, pontoon, berth_number, city) is stored as a nested object inside each boat, for example pontoon "C"; no collection holds berths as separate documents.

The customer's licence details (license_number, license_type, issuing_country, expiry_date) live in a nested object inside the customer document, for example license_type "icc"; licences have no collection of their own.
The payment of a rental (method, amount_paid_eur, paid_at, card_last4) is a nested object inside the rental, for example method "bank_transfer"; there is no payments collection.
boat_id holds only the ObjectId of a document in boats; no boat attributes such as name or daily_rate_eur are copied into the rental.
customer_id holds only the ObjectId of a document in customers; no customer attributes such as name or email are copied into the rental.
